intelligence.human_view: This is the standard behind the standard. Everything he has ruled tonight — the fold as the experience, depth everywhere, the emblem, "when it looks for real, they take you for real," eliteness, triple-A, fine art — lands here, in one place, as five pillars and one governing principle. Naya is not another product competing with existing software; it is an entirely different standard of creation. The governing principle is the test every seat can run without asking him: don't optimize for what software has traditionally been — optimize for what software should be at its absolute best. Don't accept 8/10 when there's a practical, meaningful path to 10/10. And don't confuse decoration with excellence — beauty must be supported by substance, performance, integrity and real human value. That last line is the guardrail on everything else: the beauty is real only when the substance is real.
intelligence.simple_view: Naya isn't just another app — it's a whole new way of making things! Everything has to be the very best: beautiful, easy, smart, and all connected together. Never settle for just okay when we can make it perfect!

(3) FINE-ART EXPERIENCE — PEOPLE GENUINELY LOVE USING IT. (4) INTELLIGENCE INSIDE AND OUT. (5) ONE COHERENT CIVILIZATION. GOVERNING PRINCIPLE: DON'T OPTIMIZE FOR WHAT SOFTWARE HAS TRADITIONALLY BEEN — OPTIMIZE FOR WHAT SOFTWARE SHOULD BE AT ITS ABSOLUTE BEST. DON'T ACCEPT 8/10 WHEN THERE'S A PRACTICAL, MEANINGFUL PATH TO 10/10. BEAUTY MUST BE SUPPORTED BY SUBSTANCE, PERFORMANCE, INTEGRITY AND REAL HUMAN VALUE. NAYA: BEYOND EXTRAORDINARY. THE ULTIMATE THING, CREATED THE ULTIMATE WAY.
